title: Copilot Studio: SharePoint lists as an agent knowledge source
summary: Hold: the consumption-only licensing classification does not reflect the documented licence-covered standard-harness usage that the body itself describes. Two additional statements go beyond the evidence: the precise environment holding ingested list content, and the promise that unsupported sources produce gaps rather than errors.

claims.claim: Makers connecting list views, document libraries or attachments will see gaps rather than errors.

claims.fix: Replace 'Makers who connect those will see gaps rather than errors' with 'For attachments, Learn says the list is indexed without an error, but responses do not use attachment contents.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/requirements-quotas.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing: Licence
claims.claim: The feature's licensing model is consumption-only even though the page covers both harnesses and documents licence-included standard-harness use.
claims.quote: model: "consumption"; "For standard harness agents, the billing rates page says employee-facing usage is included in the Microsoft Copilot user licence when the user is licensed and the agent operates using that user's identity."
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'mixed'. Add to licensing.notes: 'For standard-harness agents, employee-facing usage is included in the Microsoft Copilot USL when the user is licensed and the agent uses that authenticated user's identity, subject to fair usage limits.' This is stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/requirements-messages-management. Retain the separately qualified Microsoft Copilot harness consumption rule.

claims.claim: Standard-harness employee-facing agent usage is included in the Microsoft Copilot USL when the user is licensed and the agent uses that user's authenticated identity.
claims.quote: are included in the Microsoft Copilot USL when the user of the agent is licensed with Microsoft Copilot, and the agent operates using the authenticated Microsoft Copilot USL user's identity.

claims.claim: An agent monthly consumption limit can have a hard stop that turns off the agent at its limit.
claims.quote: Hard stop: The agent is automatically turned off once it hits the defined limit.

claims.claim: Agent limits are not applied instantly.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.quote: To manage Copilot Studio capacity, you need the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: The SharePoint + OneDrive rule is reached in Power Platform admin center through Security > Data and privacy > Knowledge sources for agents > Environment groups > environment group > Manage knowledge sources > SharePoint + OneDrive.
claims.quote: select Security. ... select ... Data and privacy ... Knowledge sources for agents ... Environment groups ... Select the environment group ... select Manage knowledge sources. ... SharePoint + OneDrive

claims.claim: No documented automation operation sets this Knowledge sources for agents rule.
claims.quote: Searched: Knowledge sources for agents API SharePoint; Knowledge sources for agents PowerShell rule. Opened knowledge-sources-for-agents-rule, pac governance and Power Platform Rule Sets Update Rule Set. Generic rule-set operations give no identifier or value schema for this control.

claims.claim: Knowledge sources for agents can be configured at environment-group or environment scope.
claims.quote: This setting is available at both the environment and environment group level.

claims.claim: SharePoint + OneDrive offers None, All and Custom options.
claims.quote: SharePoint + OneDrive ... Choose from three options: ... None ... All ... Custom

claims.claim: Custom allows or denies SharePoint and OneDrive sites by URL.
claims.quote: Custom: Select which SharePoint and OneDrive sites agents can use. Agents reference them in priority order, starting with the first URL. Select either Allow or Deny under Access for each URL.

claims.claim: The documentation does not explain how Custom treats individual list URLs.
claims.quote: Searched: Knowledge sources for agents list URLs. Opened knowledge-sources-for-agents-rule and choose-knowledge-sources. They describe site URLs and the source mapping, not evaluation of individual list URLs; Agent Builder list-URL results address adding knowledge, not this rule.

claims.claim: A group-level knowledge-source rule is distributed to environments and cannot be changed at environment level.
claims.quote: if an admin sets the control at the environment group level, then it's distributed to the environment level and can't be modified there.

claims.claim: The capacity page documents Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Agents for monthly agent limits.
claims.quote: On the navigation pane, select Licensing. ... under Products, select Copilot Studio. ... On the Summary tab, select Manage Agents.

claims.claim: No documented API or PowerShell operation configures an individual agent's monthly Copilot Credit limit.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Platform API agent limit monthly; agent monthly limit PowerShell Copilot Credits; Dataverse bot consumption limit. Opened manage-usage-github-copilot-harness, capacity management and Dataverse bot Web API reference; no monthly-limit property or setting operation was documented.

claims.claim: After Manage Agents, select an agent, select Set limit and enable Stop usage to turn it off at the limit.
claims.quote: Select the agent, and then select Set limit. ... Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: Agent monthly limits apply to Copilot Studio agents generally rather than only this list-knowledge feature.
claims.quote: Admins can set monthly consumption limits for each Copilot Studio agent, regardless of whether the environment uses prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.

claims.claim: The Upload files > SharePoint entry is mapped to the SharePoint + OneDrive knowledge-source setting.
claims.quote: | Upload files > SharePoint | SharePoint + OneDrive | Configures whether agents can use SharePoint and OneDrive sites as knowledge sources. |
claims.fix: In Governance controls, replace 'Its table lists' with 'The Choose knowledge sources for agents built in Copilot Studio table lists'. The mapping is on the already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/choose-knowledge-sources, not the Knowledge sources for agents configuration page.

claims.claim: The pac governance reference provides rule-set commands but does not name this knowledge-source rule.
claims.quote: Searched: Knowledge sources for agents API SharePoint; Knowledge sources for agents PowerShell rule. Read the full pac governance reference: create-rule-set and update-rule-set accept generic parameters; no Knowledge sources for agents rule name or parameters are specified.

claims.claim: Power Platform administrators can configure environment-group rules.
claims.quote: After you create the environment group, Power Platform tenant administrators can immediately add managed environments or configure the group's rules.
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/environment-groups for the Power Platform administrator assignment in the first Before rollout bullet.

claims.claim: SharePoint site owners can review and change list permissions.
claims.quote: Lists and libraries inherit permissions from the site to which they belong. If you're a site owner, you can stop permissions inheritance and change the permission settings for the list or library.
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/understanding-permission-levels for assigning list-permission review to SharePoint site owners.

claims.claim: Learn's list-knowledge best practices advise evaluations before production.
claims.quote: Run evaluations and validate your queries before production rollout.

claims.claim: Manage Agents displays month-to-date billed credits and agent status.
claims.quote: See month-to-date billed credits. ... Monitor agent status, such as Nearing limit, Over limit, or Within limit.

claims.claim: The downloadable detailed consumption report includes a Knowledge sources / Tool used column.
claims.quote: The detailed report adds the Product / AI feature, Channel, LLM model, and Knowledge sources / Tool used columns.
